response.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_mean FROM equipment_avg), above_average AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.avg_humidity > o.overall_mean), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_group_mean FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, a.avg_humidity - g.above_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN group_mean g WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST, a.equipref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average across all equipment gives each equipment item with a humidity reading equal weight, using its average humidity.

alternatives.interpretation: The average across all equipment is the average of all humidity readings, so equipment with more readings has more weight in that reference average.
